Joint width about0.8% of full image width, crisp rounded intersections, subtle bevel highlights no more than1pixel beyond joint. No black outlines, no exaggerated relief, no irregular mosaic. Reduce mottling and speckle contrast within each tile so joints are primary detail. Uniform brightness over whole image, no center glow or directional overall shadow. SEAMLESS BOTH AXES: square grid must align exactly at opposite edges; place tile centers at the corners, so boundary cuts through middle of a tile, with grout lines at12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5% along BOTH axes. correctionPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct only the grid phase of this warm beige square paving texture to make it wrap in both directions. Keep exactly the same material, colors, grout contrast and size of a full square tile. Move the grid by HALF A TILE in BOTH directions. The output must have FOUR vertical grout lines at x=12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5%, and FOUR horizontal grout lines at y=12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5%. Thus along every outer border are HALF tiles, and the four corners are QUARTER tiles. There are FIVE visible tile columns/rows: half, full, full, full, half. Do not keep the current three lines at25%,50%,75%: that creates double-width tiles at repeats. Keep image opaque, strict topdown, square, no perspective, no added objects or gradients. Preserve the bold continuous warm brown grout and warm ivory tile faces.
